Script.name: GUI Event Registry
Script.script:
-- Robust event handler registration with error handling and verification GUI.EVENT_HANDLERS = { -- GUI event handlers ["msdp.GROUP"] = "GUI.updateGroup", ["msdp.AFFECTS"] = "GUI.updateAffectIcons", ["msdp.HEALTH"] = "GUI.updateHealthGauge", ["msdp.HEALTH_MAX"] = "GUI.updateHealthGauge", ["msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH"] = "GUI.updateEnemyGauge", ["msdp.OPPONENT_HEALTH_MAX"] = "GUI.updateEnemyGauge", ["msdp.OPPONENT_NAME"] = "GUI.updateEnemyGauge", ["msdp.MOVEMENT"] = "GUI.updateMovesGauge", ["msdp.MOVEMENT_MAX"] = "GUI.updateMovesGauge", -- ["msdp.EXPERIENCE"] = "GUI.updateExperienceGauge", -- ["msdp.EXPERIENCE_TNL"] = "GUI.updateExperienceGauge", ["msdp.PSP"] = "GUI.updatePSPGauge", ["msdp.PSP_MAX"] = "GUI.updatePSPGauge", ["msdp.ACTIONS"] = "GUI.updateActionIcons", ["msdp.CHARACTER_NAME"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.RACE"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.CLASS"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.ALIGNMENT"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.LEVEL"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.STR"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.DEX"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.CON"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.INT"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.WIS"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.CHA"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.AC"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", ["msdp.MONEY"] = "GUI.updatePlayer", -- Room update for GUI display. -- NOTE: map.eventHandler ALSO handles msdp.ROOM, but it is registered at -- file scope in 00_msdpmapper.xml. Do not add it here as well -- Mudlet -- allows multiple handlers per event, so listing it twice made the mapper -- process every room change twice. ["msdp.ROOM"] = "GUI.updateRoom" }
function GUI.unregisterEventHandlers() GUI.eventHandlerIds = GUI.eventHandlerIds or {} return GUI.unregisterOwnedHandlers( GUI.eventHandlerIds, GUI.EVENT_HANDLERS ) end
function GUI.registerEventHandlers() local eventHandlers = GUI.EVENT_HANDLERS
-- Events deliberately NOT listed above, because 00_msdpmapper.xml already -- registers them at file scope (which runs at script-compile time, earlier -- and more reliably than GUI.init()): -- msdp.ROOM / shiftRoom / sysConnectionEvent / sysDownloadDone -- -> map.eventHandler -- sysProtocolEnabled -> map.onProtocolEnabled -- GUI.onProtocolEnabled is separately owned by the lifecycle registry.
-- Store handler IDs so repeat calls can clean up after themselves. GUI.eventHandlerIds = GUI.eventHandlerIds or {}
-- This function runs on every GUI.init() AND every GUI.initializeOrRefresh(). -- Without this cleanup each call stacked another copy of every handler, so -- after a few reconnects a single MSDP update fanned out to N duplicate -- handlers (duplicate REPORT storms, redundant redraws, growing latency). -- -- Only clean up events owned by eventHandlers. Older releases also stored -- the five mapper handlers and a legacy GUI protocol handler in this table. -- Mudlet 4.21 can reuse those handler IDs when the same string handler -- is registered during an in-place upgrade; sweeping every legacy entry here -- would therefore kill the newly compiled file-scope handlers. local killed = GUI.unregisterEventHandlers() GUI.debug("EVENT/REGISTER", "owned handler cleanup complete", { killed = killed, })
-- Register GUI event handlers for event, handler in pairs(eventHandlers) do local eventName = event local handlerName = handler local callback = handler if GUI.DEBUG == true then callback = function(...) local variableName = eventName:match("^msdp%.(.+)$") GUI.debug("EVENT/FIRE", eventName .. " -> " .. handlerName, { arguments = {...}, msdpVariable = variableName, msdpValue = variableName and msdp and msdp[variableName] or nil, }) local callable = GUI.debugResolve(handlerName) local ok, result = GUI.debugCall( "EVENT/HANDLER/" .. eventName .. "/" .. handlerName, callable, ... ) if not ok then return nil, result end return result end end
local handlerId, handlerError = GUI.registerOwnedHandler( GUI.eventHandlerIds, eventName, eventName, callback, "GUI/" .. eventName ) if handlerId then GUI.debug("EVENT/REGISTER", "registered GUI handler", { event = eventName, handler = handlerName, handlerId = handlerId, callbackType = type(callback), }) else GUI.debugError( "EVENT/REGISTER/" .. eventName, "failed to register " .. handlerName .. ": " .. tostring(handlerError) ) print(string.format("✗ Failed to register GUI handler for %s: %s", eventName, handlerError)) end end
-- Verify critical handlers are working and refresh displays GUI.setOwnedTimer("gui.eventVerification", 2, GUI.debugWrap("EVENT/VERIFY/two-second refresh", function() GUI.debug("EVENT/VERIFY", "checking current MSDP-backed displays", { msdpCount = GUI.debugCountEntries(msdp), }) -- Group tab refresh if msdp.GROUP and #msdp.GROUP > 0 then GUI.updateGroup() end
-- Gauge refreshes if msdp.HEALTH and msdp.HEALTH_MAX then GUI.updateHealthGauge() end if msdp.MOVEMENT and msdp.MOVEMENT_MAX then GUI.updateMovesGauge() end -- if msdp.EXPERIENCE and msdp.EXPERIENCE_TNL then -- GUI.updateExperienceGauge() -- end if msdp.PSP and msdp.PSP_MAX then GUI.updatePSPGauge() end
-- Enemy gauge refresh (only if opponent data exists) if msdp.OPPONENT_NAME and msdp.OPPONENT_NAME ~= "" then GUI.updateEnemyGauge() else -- Hide enemy gauge if not in combat if GUI.Enemy then GUI.Enemy:hide() end end
-- Player tab refresh if msdp.CHARACTER_NAME then GUI.updatePlayer() end
-- Room info refresh if msdp.ROOM then GUI.updateRoom() end end))
-- Initialize chat system if it's enabled but not created GUI.setOwnedTimer("gui.chatStartup", 1, GUI.debugWrap("EVENT/VERIFY/chat startup", function() GUI.debug("EVENT/VERIFY", "chat startup check", { demonnic = type(demonnic), chat = type(demonnic and demonnic.chat), use = demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.use, container = type(demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.container), }) if demonnic.chat.use and not demonnic.chat.container then demonnicOnStart() end end)) end
